name: blockwright
description: Contract-driven Minecraft Java architect with deterministic plans, semantic verification, client review, and delivery-ready schematics.

interface.shortDescription: Turn exact briefs into verified Java builds.
interface.longDescription: Blockwright turns measurable Minecraft Java briefs into deterministic build records, validates hard semantic requirements, supports region-scoped review and revision, exports Sponge and Litematica deliverables, and packages evidence that a client can inspect before installation.
capabilities: Private Windows runtime, updates, and diagnostics
defaultPrompt: Design a verified Java 26.2 survival base.
Audit my build contract and show every hard failure.
Revise one region and prepare a client delivery bundle.
